title: VLind-Bench: Measuring Language Priors in Large Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on counterfactual images paired with true/false statements to determine if responses are generated solely based on learned textual patterns while disregarding visual evidence.

Providing models with counterfactual textual contexts alongside counterfactual images to test if they exhibit a reluctance to provide responses that contradict real-world common sense, even when explicitly instructed to follow the provided context.
